name: Dismantlable Ample Classes Are Strictly Corner-Peelable COMs
scope: Finite simple COMs and their tope graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every dismantlable ample class has a COM corner peeling, and the containment is strict.
proof: For ample classes the COM corner notion reduces to the usual single-vertex corner, so a dismantling order is a corner peeling. The realizable COM $C_6$ has a corner peeling but is not ample.
